floorPlans.label: The Grove original brochure and villa plans · Sobha Realty
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the four-, five- and six-bedroom estate villas. Each complete sheet includes the available floor levels, outdoor layout and applicable saleable area.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a villa layout at The Grove
floorPlans.note: The figures shown are the developer’s saleable area. Plot sizes are separate and can vary by plot. Check the original sheet and confirm the final figures for your villa.

review.images: Eight native artwork layers from The Grove brochure pages 17–24. The gallery uses the named estate villa exteriors and interiors, plus an aerial illustration of the enclave.
review.location: The Grove’s named plot plan is on physical page 27. The developer’s Sanctuary marker provides community directions. The Grove’s own page supplies five approximate journey estimates.
review.floorPlans: All 12 full estate-villa sheets, physical pages 29–40, include the available floor levels. The clearly labeled square-foot saleable values are used. The four-bedroom Type BM plot minimum and some printed metric-unit labels differ between source fields, so they are not repeated as calculated site figures.

unavailable: Exact coordinates for villa entrances, current travel times, distances and completed-property photographs were unavailable in the reviewed material.
